headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Yogi Adityanath warns against attempts to tarnish Ayodhya’s image.
Telangana celebrates Deepavali with traditional fervour.
PM Modi says ‘dimagi naxals’ threaten constitution, democracy.
Taiwan detains Communist Party leader over alleged Chinese sponsorship in election.
Bangladesh Law Minister calls Hasina ‘convicted criminal’.
bullets_ur: Yogi Adityanath ne Ayodhya ka aks kharab karne ki koshishon par khabardar kiya.
Telangana mein Deepavali riwayati josh-o-kharoosh ke sath manayi gayi.
PM Modi ka kehna hai ke ‘dimagi naxals’ aaeen aur jamhooriyat ke liye khatra hain.
Taiwan ne election mein Chinese sponsorship ke ilzam par Communist Party leader ko hirasat mein liya.
Bangladesh ke Wazir-e-Qanoon ne Hasina ko ‘convicted criminal’ qarar de diya.
